Package arztis.econnector.ihe.queries

Class AssertionTransactions

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.ihe.queries.AssertionTransactions
public class AssertionTransactions
extends java.lang.Object
This class contains all functionalities to request
  • Identity assertion of SVC and ELGA ETS
  • Health care provider (HCP) assertion of ELGA ETS
  • Context assertion for electronic immunization state and virtual organization of ELGA ETS
  • e-Card only assertion of SVC

    • Method Details

      • requestIdentityAssertion

        public java.lang.Object requestIdentityAssertion​(java.lang.String dialogId, java.lang.String ticketSubject)
        This method requests identity assertion, which confirms identity of physician, who wants to register for ELGA. This assertion is needed to request HCP Assertion.
        Parameters:
        dialogId - id of the built GINA dialog
        ticketSubject - SVC ticket URL for requesting IDA (defined in configuration file)
        Returns:
        if saml ticket can be generated saml ticket is returned, otherwise Message with error details is returned

      • getRealNameForUrl

        public java.lang.String getRealNameForUrl​(java.lang.String prefix, java.lang.String suffix, java.lang.String given, java.lang.String family)
        formats real name of person that it is possible to pass full name with ticket subject of SVC. Real name will look like Dr.+Max+Mustermann+MSc. The separation with "+" sign is necessary to set full name to URL of ticket subject. This method is suggested in FAQ document of SVC.
        Parameters:
        prefix - of person
        suffix - of person
        given - name of person
        family - name of person
        Returns:
        formatted real name of person

      • requestIdentityAssertionGdaElgaArea

        public java.lang.Object requestIdentityAssertionGdaElgaArea​(java.lang.String subjectId, java.lang.String organizationId, java.lang.String issuingAuthority, java.lang.String organization)
        This method requests identity assertion, which confirms identity of user of hospital, who wants to register for ELGA. This assertion is needed to request HCP Assertion.
        Parameters:
        subjectId - Subject ID of health care provider, who wants to register
        organizationId - Organization ID (OID) of health care provider, who wants to register
        issuingAuthority - ID of issuing authority
        organization - Organization name of health care provider, who wants to register.
        Returns:
        if saml ticket can be generated saml ticket is returned, otherwise Message with error details is returned

      • requestHCPAssertion

        public java.lang.Object requestHCPAssertion​(java.lang.String pRole, java.lang.String pSamlTicket, int kindOfRequest)
        This method requests HCP Assertion, which is needed for authentication at all other ELGA requests. This Assertion has to be in the security header of every SOAP Message to request data of ELGA.
        Parameters:
        pRole - Role of health care provider to register (Possible values are available under https://termpub.gesundheit.gv.at (ELGA_GDA_Aggregatrollen))
        pSamlTicket - saml ticket, which authenticate provider of health service
        kindOfRequest - kind of requests (VO, eMedication, eImmunization, electronic records)
        Returns:
        if user registration was successful HCP Assertion is returned as AssertionType otherwise Message with error details is returned

      • requestKontextAssertion

        public java.lang.Object requestKontextAssertion​(ElgaEHealthApplication vo, AssertionType hcpAssertion, int kindOfRequest, java.lang.String role)
        This method requests context Assertion, which is needed for authentication at ELGA eHealth applications like electronic immunization record or virtual organization. This assertion has to be in security header of every SOAP message to request data of electronic immunization record or virtual organization.
        Parameters:
        vo - eHealth application for which authentication should be executed
        hcpAssertion - assertion, which authenticate health care provider
        kindOfRequest - kind of requests (VO, eMedication, eImmunization, electronic records)
        role - the role
        Returns:
        if user registration was successful Context Assertion is returned as AssertionType otherwise Message with error details is returned

      • requestEcardOnlyAssertion

        public java.lang.Object requestEcardOnlyAssertion​(java.lang.String cardToken, java.lang.String dialogId, java.lang.String ticketSubject)
        This method requests a saml ticket to be able to confirm identity of patient. The identity will be confirmed with an e-Card.
        Parameters:
        cardToken - card token of used e-Card
        dialogId - id of actual GINA dialog
        ticketSubject - SVC ticket subject to confirm identity of patient
        Returns:
        if saml ticket can be generated saml ticket is returned, otherwise Message with error details is returned
